reasons.geometry: Viewport, preview, media, chart or algorithm geometry. Review together with interaction math; not a density claim.
reasons.svg-geometry: SVG coordinate-system geometry, not a page spacing or CSS radius decision.
reasons.chart-coordinates: Tooltip anchor is aligned to the fixed chart coordinate system (228/230). It must change with that coordinate system, not with UI density.
reasons.responsive-geometry: Viewport threshold and clamp multiplier select a responsive layout. Actual spacing inside this expression uses shared tokens; thresholds do not scale with density.
reasons.native-chrome: The native macOS title lane reserves 150px on each side for OS traffic lights and history actions; its inset follows the host titlebar-area geometry, independently of UI density.
reasons.site-layout: Site composition: 96rem maximum canvas, 20rem reserved documentation column, and 14rem search-label span. These reading/layout widths are independent of control density; their insets use shared spacing tokens.
reasons.hidden-test-node: Invisible, aria-hidden dashboard counter keeps a one-pixel frame for test discovery; it is neither a separator nor a visible control.
reasons.supplied-icon: The supplied iPhone and desktop SVG paths retain their original 0.85 ink opacity. Their tint follows currentColor; this exception is limited to these two PlatformIcon assets.
reasons.fixed-media: The AppDrop QR image keeps its white surrounding quiet zone in every theme so its fixed dark modules remain scannable. This exception applies only to the view immediately containing that QR asset.
reasons.pattern: Explicit border or line pattern recipe. Exact Tamber has no generic string/enum token.
reasons.semantics: Intrinsic layout, inheritance, transparent paint, reset or full/hidden state endpoint.
reasons.typography: Semantic italic/normal distinction; real font faces remain required.
reasons.sdk-motion: Exact currently rejects number/length tokens in these keyframe rows. Geometry or opacity must remain literal; durations and easing are still shared tokens.
reasons.needs-review: Unclassified visual decision: move to a shared token or document a specific exception.
